data.text/markdown:
phasewall explorer

phasewall finds the phases of a simulated system from runs on a grid of parameters: it describes every snapshot, compares neighbouring parameter points and places a wall wherever the description jumps more than it varies within one point. Choose the runs, the frame, the descriptions and the methods in the panel on the left, then press Run. Steps already computed with the same settings are read from the cache.
